targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 10 SECOND) AS time, SeverityText AS severity, count() AS events FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE ServiceName = 'invoice-reconciliation' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY time, severity ORDER BY time

SELECT Timestamp AS timestamp, Body AS body, SeverityText AS level, LogAttributes['event.source'] AS source, LogAttributes['operation.name'] AS operation, LogAttributes['threat.category'] AS category, LogAttributes['http.response.status_code'] AS http_status, LogAttributes['duration.ms'] AS duration_ms, LogAttributes['reconciliation.run_id'] AS run_id FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE ServiceName = 'invoice-reconciliation' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200
